title: 托福官方套题 08 · 口语

tasks.sample: Begin by plugging in the power cord.
Attach the internet cable as shown.
Adjust the antenna on the device for a stronger signal.
Check the indicator lights to ensure the router is working.
Log in to the system using your computer's keyboard.
You can then create a new safe and secure Wi-Fi password for your network.
If you experience issues with the connection, try restarting your computer.

tasks.stem: (Interviewer) Thank you for taking the time to speak with me. I'd like to ask you some questions about your fitness habits.[2-second pause] To start, what kinds of exercise do you think are most popular among people your age? For example, do they prefer running, swimming, yoga, or other types?

(Interviewer) I see. Some people prefer going to gyms or working out at home, while others enjoy outdoor activities like biking or walking. In your opinion, is it more enjoyable to be active indoors or outdoors? Why?

(Interviewer) Interesting. Next, I'd like to get your opinion. In recent years, many people have started using fitness apps and online workout programs to help them stay fit. Do you think that digital tools can effectively replace traditional gym memberships? Why or why not?

(Interviewer) Good points. I just have one more question. Some people believe that physical fitness is essential for overall well-being and future health. Do you agree with this idea, or do you think there are other important factors to consider? Explain why you think so.
